title: Motorcycles - Worldwide
highlights: The projected revenue in the Motorcycles market for Worldwide is expected to reach US$132.78bn in 2026.
It is anticipated that the revenue will show an annual growth rate (CAGR 2026-2031) of 0.62%, resulting in a projected market volume of US$136.92bn by 2031.
The largest segment in the market is On-road Motorcycles, which is projected to have a market volume of US$93.22bn in 2026.
The unit sales of Motorcycles market are expected to reach 54.33m motorcyles by 2031.
In 2026, the volume weighted average price of Motorcycles market in the Worldwide market is expected to be US$2.67k.
Honda Motorcycles is projected to have the highest market share in the selected region, with a motorcycle unit sales share of 16.5% in 2026.
The value market share of Honda Motorcycles in the selected region is expected to stand at 13.9% in 2026.
From an international perspective, it is shown that the most revenue in the Motorcycles market will be generated India, with US$34.98bn in 2026.
In the United States, the trend in the motorcycle market is shifting towards electric bikes, as consumers become more environmentally conscious.
